title: Concept: package-lock.json served in a response
description: A package-lock document with its lockfile version in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: The lock file lists every direct and transitive dependency with an exact version and integrity hash, which gives an attacker a precise list of components to match against known vulnerabilities.
applicability: An exact dependency inventory turns broad scanning into a targeted exploit list.
risk: The lock file is build metadata, not content a client needs.
